title: Summer and Fall Raku (Standard Raku)
source_quote: Our summer and fall dates for Raku are now online! Join us to fire our raku kilns, handle the reduction chambers, and reveal your glowing, ​one-of-a-kind creations. The first firing will be held on July 26*.
summary: Raku firing dates throughout summer and fall where participants fire their work in District Clay's raku kilns, handle reduction chambers, and reveal finished pieces. First firing July 26.
evidence_sentence: District Clay offers summer and fall raku firings where participants fire their raku kilns and handle reduction chambers.
